note.p: There seem to be many contacts with Holm, and little reason to think that H Holm is being used to distinguish two Holms. It is possible that the H stands for Herr and that Holm is German. There is also one H H Holm, which, again, does not seem to distinguish the individual from the other Holms. But there are instances where he says 2 Holm and 3 Holms, and one occasion on which he refers to Holm Senior, so there is a larger family. There are a great many individual calls back and forth, but Holm is also met regularly at Mrs Woods, and also at Martins , Sass's and L. Stanhope. Which suggests a certain status. He also goes with Godwin (talkes Godwin) on the three occasions Godwin goes to an event given by the phrenologist Spuzheim; and he accompanies Godwin to King's College on one occasion. We are currently treating all the Holms as one Holm!
The pattern of visits is odd, with frequent interaction and then periods in which Holm seems to be away.
